	province_culture_modifier = {
		parameter = industrious_productivity_bonus
		trade_good_wool_production_mult = 0.1
		monthly_agricultural_tax = industrious_tradition_tax_bonus_low
	}

	province_culture_modifier = {
		parameter = pastoralists_district_bonuses
		stationed_light_cavalry_maintenance_low_modifier = -0.02
		stationed_light_cavalry_maintenance_high_modifier = -0.02
		agricultural_tax_mult = 0.01
		levy_size = 0.01
	}

	on_complete = {
	}
	next_building = wool_resource_building_2
	type_icon = "district_buildings/wool_district.dds"

		parameter = butter_tea_drinking
		trade_good_tea_sell_price_mult = regional_demand_price_mult
	}
	trade_good_need = {

            }
        }
    }

            AND = {

        }
    }

            AND = {
	
            }
        }

	}

		trade_good_wool_production_mult = 0.25
	}

	province_culture_modifier = {

		trade_good_wool_production_mult = 0.1
		monthly_agricultural_tax = industrious_tradition_tax_bonus_mid
	}

	province_culture_modifier = {
		parameter = pastoralists_district_bonuses
		stationed_light_cavalry_maintenance_low_modifier = -0.02
		stationed_light_cavalry_maintenance_high_modifier = -0.02

		levy_size = 0.07

	province_government_modifier = {
		not_parameter = government_is_tribal
		monthly_agricultural_tax = textiles_income_tier_4
	}
	province_government_modifier = {
		parameter = government_is_tribal
		monthly_agricultural_tax = textiles_income_tier_4_tribal
	}

		trade_good_wool_sell_price_mult = price_textiles_building_1
	}
	trade_good_need = {
		trade_good = trade_good_wool
		amount = textiles_wool_need_per_level

		can_be_filled_multiple_times = 4
		modifiers = {

			}
			province_government_modifier = {
				not_parameter = government_is_tribal

	construction_time = construction_time_9_months
	district_level_requirement = {
        value = 5
        if = { limit = { has_variable = DI_tm_building_edit_active } value = 0 }
    }
	can_construct_potential = {
        OR = {
            has_variable = DI_tm_building_edit_active
            AND = {
		building_requirement_non_tribal = yes
	
            }
        }
    }
	can_construct_showing_failures_only = {
        OR = {
            has_variable = DI_tm_building_edit_active
            AND = {
	
            }
        }
    }
	show_disabled = yes
	can_construct = {
        OR = {
            has_variable = DI_tm_building_edit_active
            AND = {
	
            }
        }
    }
	cost_gold = resource_district_expensive_tier_2_cost
	province_modifier = {
		trade_good_textiles_production_mult = fulling_mill_textiles_mult_tier_2
		artisan_tax_mult = fulling_mill_artisan_tax_mult_tier_2
	}
	on_complete = {
	}
	next_building = fulling_mill_3
	ai_value = {
		base = 10
		ai_resource_building_need_modifier = { GOOD = trade_good_textiles }
		directive_to_build_economy_modifier = yes
		ai_income_building_modifier = yes
		ai_market_shortage_modifier = { GOOD = trade_good_textiles }
		ai_resource_building_upgrade_modifier = { LEVEL = 2 }
	}
}

wool_cheesemaker_1 = {
	construction_time = construction_time_6_months
	can_construct_potential = {
        OR = {
            has_variable = DI_tm_building_edit_active
            AND = {
		building_requirement_non_tribal = yes
	
            }
        }
    }
	can_construct_showing_failures_only = {
        OR = {
            has_variable = DI_tm_building_edit_active
            AND = {
	
            }
        }
    }
	show_disabled = yes
	can_construct = {
        OR = {
            has_variable = DI_tm_building_edit_active
            AND = {
	
            }
        }
    }
	cost_gold = resource_district_normal_tier_1_cost
	province_government_modifier = {
		not_parameter = government_is_tribal
		monthly_agricultural_tax = wool_cheesemaker_income_tier_1
	}
	province_government_modifier = {
		parameter = government_is_tribal
		monthly_agricultural_tax = wool_cheesemaker_income_tier_1_tribal
	}
	market_modifier = {
		trade_good_salt_sell_price_mult = price_basic_building_1
	}
	trade_good_need = {
		trade_good = trade_good_salt
		amount = low_resource_district_need
		modifiers = {
			province_modifier = {
				trade_good_cheese_production_add = wool_cheese_output_from_salt_per_level
			}
			province_government_modifier = {
				not_parameter = government_is_tribal
				monthly_agricultural_tax = monthly_tax_per_cheese_level
			}
			province_government_modifier = {
				parameter = government_is_tribal
				monthly_agricultural_tax = monthly_tax_per_cheese_level_tribal
			}
		}
	}
	on_complete = {
	}
	next_building = wool_cheesemaker_2
	type_icon = "resource_buildings/wool_cheesemaker.dds"
	ai_value = {
		base = 10
		ai_resource_building_need_category_modifier = { GOOD = trade_good_cheese CATEGORY = trade_category_comforts }
		ai_resource_building_consumer_category_modifier = { GOOD = trade_good_salt CATEGORY = trade_category_salt }
		directive_to_build_economy_modifier = yes
		ai_income_building_modifier = yes
		ai_market_category_shortage_modifier = { GOOD = trade_good_cheese CATEGORY = trade_category_comforts }
		ai_resource_new_building_modifier = yes
	}
}
